personality-v1:facet-duty-bound.estimatedFrom: ESTIMATED FROM RECORDS AND PUBLIC DATA: available parents, household adults, payroll, place and congregation records are used first. Missing sibling counts use the national U.S. Census SIPP 2009 distribution and missing pay bands use ACS 2024 B17024; both are labeled estimates and sampled by the person's stable generation key. Caregiver availability uses recorded adults or a saved family pattern's parents per child. Cohort scope: exact; exact place/type/income first, same place next, then the game's recorded families. Current payroll takes priority; otherwise the existing BLS May 2025 place/occupation wage reader and recorded job tenure/hours supply a labeled pay proxy. Income contributors are retained in incomeSourcePersonIds. No relative, emotional treatment, faith or event is created. ESTIMATED FROM RECORDS AND NATIONAL DATA: siblings, congregation, household pay, caregivers per child, school-year moves and a parent's death are weighed smoothly; missing sibling counts use sipp-2009-p70-126-table-4, and missing pay bands use acs-2024-1yr-b17024-adolescence. ESTIMATED FROM THE NATIONAL DISTRIBUTION: no household pay is recorded for this childhood period, so a stable sample for this person uses the ACS 2024 1-year B17024 U.S. child distribution for early-childhood. ESTIMATED FROM THE NATIONAL DISTRIBUTION: no household pay is recorded for this childhood period, so a stable sample for this person uses the ACS 2024 1-year B17024 U.S. child distribution for adolescence. Canonical sparse upbringing trait projection; no traits inferred from names or gender.
